title: Tali Lepas
description: {name} has knotted ropes everywhere and can only hop. Drag the knots until no two ropes cross, as many boards as you can in 90 seconds.

how.en: Drag the knots with your finger or mouse until no rope crosses another (crossing ropes glow red). Faster solves score more. Stuck? Skip the level for -5 points. You have 90 seconds.
how.id: Seret simpulnya dengan jari atau mouse sampai tidak ada tali yang bersilang (tali bersilang menyala merah). Makin cepat selesai, makin tinggi skornya. Buntu? Lewati level dengan -5 poin. Waktumu 90 detik.

en: That's a knot. Still a knot. I'd help, but I can only hop.
Ropes don't untangle themselves. Believe me, I've waited.
id: Itu masih kusut. Tetap kusut. Aku mau bantu, tapi aku cuma bisa lompat.
Tali nggak bakal lepas sendiri. Percaya deh, aku sudah lama nunggu.

en: Not bad. Most of it came loose. Don't get proud.
Fine, that was decent. I almost watched without sighing.
id: Lumayan. Sebagian besar sudah lepas. Jangan sombong dulu.
Ya sudah, itu lumayan. Aku nonton tanpa menghela napas, hampir.

en: Everything came loose. I'm glad you were the one holding it.
That was clean. Quick hands. I'd tell you if it was bad, so believe me.
id: Semuanya lepas. Aku lega kamu yang pegang talinya.
Itu rapi. Tanganmu cepat. Kalau jelek aku bilang jelek, jadi percayalah.

en: A new best. I'm not smiling. My face just doesn't move. But I'm glad.
Record. Good. Rest your hands now. I mean it.
id: Rekor baru. Aku nggak senyum. Mukaku memang kaku. Tapi aku senang.
Rekor. Bagus. Istirahatin tanganmu sekarang, aku serius.

id.description: {name} dikelilingi tali kusut dan cuma bisa lompat. Seret simpulnya sampai tidak ada dua tali yang bersilang, sebanyak mungkin papan dalam 90 detik.
